subject: 3rd day of the 2nd tenday of Taraskh, 1492
fact: The events of the prison exploration begin on the 3rd day of the 2nd tenday of Taraskh, 1492.
source_quote: 3rd day of the 2nd tenday of Taraskh, 1492

subject: prison
fact: The prison is located 100’ in the sky with a direct drop that would be suicidal.
source_quote: the Drow outpost was 100’ in the sky. A direct drop would be suicidal.

subject: prison cell
fact: The prison cell faces a stalactite with a door and two bored Drow beyond it.
source_quote: Across from his prison cell is a stalactite. There is a door, and two very bored Drow are past the door.

subject: bridge near the waterfall
fact: The bridge near the waterfall has a winch-and-basket device with a spider silk cord, pulleys, and a hand-cranked horizontal spool.
source_quote: As he crosses the bridge near the waterfall... attached to the edge of the barracks platform is a winch-and-basket device consisting of a giant swinging arm that carries a thin cord of strong spider silk. The cord runs through several pulleys from a hand-cranked horizontal spool to a heavy woven basket suspended at the end.

subject: spider silk cord
fact: The winch-and-basket device uses a thin cord of strong spider silk.
source_quote: a thin cord of strong spider silk

subject: heavy woven basket
fact: The winch-and-basket device has a heavy woven basket suspended at the end of the spider silk cord.
source_quote: a heavy woven basket suspended at the end

subject: piece of paper
fact: Zalthir finds a piece of paper with names of people who owe a favor, and pockets it.
source_quote: a piece of paper with some names of people who owe a favor to the person who has the paper

subject: comb
fact: Elspeth finds and pockets a comb while Zalthir pockets the piece of paper.
source_quote: He notices that Elspeth sees him pocket the paper. He notices that she finds a comb. She pockets the comb.

subject: mess hall
fact: The mess hall is a cave with four circular zurkhwood tables, each with five chairs.
source_quote: It has four circular tables carved from zurkhwood, each surrounded by five chairs.

subject: mess hall
fact: The mess hall has a food preparation and storage area with dried and fresh fungi, dried fruits, cheeses, preserved meat, and clay jars of spices.
source_quote: Part of the hall is used as a food preparation and storage area, containing stocks of dried and fresh fungi, dried fruits, cheeses, preserved meat, and a few clay jars of spices.

subject: heavy iron brazier
fact: The mess hall contains a heavy iron brazier that provides cooking heat and dim light.
source_quote: A heavy iron brazier provides cooking heat and dim light

subject: Jaezred
fact: Jaezred is a Drow sitting at a table in the mess hall, looking hungry.
source_quote: There are a pair of Drow sitting at a table, looking hungry. Shuushar mutters: “Jaezred and Kalannar”

subject: Kalannar
fact: Kalannar is a Drow sitting at a table in the mess hall, looking hungry.
source_quote: There are a pair of Drow sitting at a table, looking hungry. Shuushar mutters: “Jaezred and Kalannar”

subject: Guldor
fact: Guldor sits at the table with Jaezred and Kalannar in the mess hall.
source_quote: Guldor sits with them.

subject: Topsy
fact: Topsy is a deep gnome who whispers to Turvy and later steals knives during Gyrgum’s cooking show.
source_quote: Topsy and Turvy whisper to each other... Topsy and Turvy steal several knives.

subject: Turvy
fact: Turvy is a deep gnome who whispers to Topsy and later steals knives during Gyrgum’s cooking show.
source_quote: Topsy and Turvy whisper to each other... Topsy and Turvy steal several knives.

subject: Shuushar
fact: Shuushar is a Kuo-Toan who translates Drow speech for Gyrgum and cautions him about cooking being a better distraction.
source_quote: The Kuo-Toan Shuushar the Awakened notices and tells him to relax... Shuushar translates, “Can you cook? That would be a better distraction.”

subject: Imbros
fact: Imbros is a Drow who wants Gyrgum, Shuushar, Topsy, and Turvy to cook.
source_quote: Excellent, Imbros wants us to cook.

subject: Beremil
fact: Beremil is a Drow who leads Ront and Prince Derendil to carry water.
source_quote: The Drow who took them is Beremil.

subject: Balok
fact: Balok runs the winch and instructs prisoners to clean and unload cargo.
source_quote: Balok runs the winch. ... Balok shouts, “Stop.” ... Balok is laughing.

subject: Zalthir
fact: Zalthir is a dragonborn monk who notices a spider web, a pool of water, and pockets a piece of paper.
source_quote: Zalthir notices a spider web. Below the spider’s web, he notices a pool of water. ... He pockets the paper.

subject: Buppido
fact: Buppido is a derro who claims to follow a divine plan and believes he is a god or represents one.
source_quote: Buppido speaks, or instead projects his mind, “The Divine plan says we must collaborate and share information.” ... Daz learns from the cleric that Buppido thinks he is some kind of god, or he is a god.

subject: Jimjar
fact: Jimjar is a prisoner who repeatedly tries to make bets about the winch operations and escape routes.
source_quote: Jimjar, next to him, mutters, “Wanna bet on who would die first when we splat on the ground?” ... Jimjar again tries to make a bet... Jimjar adds, “Who wants to bet on which path the new guys will want to go?”

subject: Daz
fact: Daz is a prisoner assigned to clean chamber pots and later observes the prison cell’s group mind and Buppido’s plan.
source_quote: Another Drow points at Daz, Sarith, and Stool. Daz has a very sour expression. ... Daz notes that this allows them to coordinate any plans without being discovered. ... Daz asks, “What is the plan?”

subject: Sarith
fact: Sarith is a prisoner assigned with Daz and Stool to clean chamber pots.
source_quote: Another Drow points at Daz, Sarith, and Stool.

subject: Stool
fact: Stool is a prisoner who spreads spores to create a group mind among the prisoners and objects to going to Gracklstugh.
source_quote: The stool is happy to be talking to everyone and has spread his spores so that everyone in the prison cell is in a group mind. ... Stool objects, “No to the great circle! My people!”

subject: Ront
fact: Ront is a Quaggoth who is led by Beremil to carry water.
source_quote: Ront and Prince Derendil, the deluded Quaggoth, are to follow this Drow.

subject: Prince Derendil
fact: Prince Derendil is a deluded Quaggoth who recalls Ilvara’s greeting and her phrase about accepting fate.
source_quote: Prince Derendil mutters, “ I remember how she greeted me when I arrived. She was robed in silken garments and flanked by two male drow, one of whom had a mass of scars along one side of his face and neck. Mistress Ilvara liked to impress her will with a scourge in hand and remind her slaves that our lives now belong to her. Every time, she would end her pep talks with the phrase - ‘Accept your fate, learn to obey, and you may survive.’”

subject: Ilvara
fact: Ilvara is the high priestess of Lolth and commander of the outpost, who uses a scourge and demands obedience.
source_quote: Ilvara is there. She smiles and has her scourge handy... “I am the high priestess of Lolth and commander. Do not spill any water, do not touch anything, and fill my bath.”

subject: Eldeth
fact: Eldeth is a prisoner pointed out by a Drow to help with loading and unloading cargo.
source_quote: The next Drow appears and points to Zalthir, Buppido, Jimjar, and Eldeth.

subject: Grygum
fact: Grygum is a prisoner who cooks for the Drow and attempts to steal a knife.
source_quote: As Grygum walks towards the mess hall... Gyrgum has a peculiar expression... As Gyrgum, with theatrical flair, tosses ingredients into the air... Gyrgum notices a knife and tries to steal it.

subject: Thorin
fact: Thorin is a dwarf who observes the waterfall, speaks with Jorlan, and participates in escape planning.
source_quote: Thorin is standing on the other side of the bridge south of the prison cell... Thorin remembers all these free-for-all conversations... Thorin connected to his friends via the spores... Thorin is satisfied.

subject: Jorlan
fact: Jorlan is a former number-one servant of Ilvara who was disfigured by acid and now offers to help the prisoners escape.
source_quote: Sethir says, “That’s Jorlan. He used to be the number one, but after he got hit with acid, his face was disfigured and he lost a finger, Ilvara’s dropped him... Jorlan turns to Thorin, “If I made it possible for you to escape, would you try?”

subject: Shoor
fact: Shoor is the current number-one servant of Ilvara, replacing Jorlan.
source_quote: Sethir says, “... now Shoor is number one.”

subject: Sethir
fact: Sethir is a member of Ilvara’s polycule who identifies Jorlan to Thorin.
source_quote: Sethir says, “That’s Jorlan. He used to be the number one, but after he got hit with acid, his face was disfigured and he lost a finger, Ilvara’s dropped him, and now Shoor is number one.”

subject: priestess’s tower
fact: The priestess’s tower is the uppermost level of the largest hanging tower and contains a shrine to Lolth.
source_quote: Water in tow, Ronk, Thorin, and Prince Derendil enter the uppermost level of the largest hanging tower, called the priestess’s tower.

subject: priestess’s tower
fact: The priestess’s tower’s chamber has dark silken mats with a pale web-strand pattern woven in silvery thread.
source_quote: Dark silken mats cover the floor of this circular chamber with a pale web-strand pattern woven through them in silvery thread.

subject: priestess’s tower
fact: The priestess’s tower’s chamber has a broad zurkhwood pedestal with a 10-foot-high sculpted spider at its head.
source_quote: In the middle of the chamber (at the center of the web) stands a broad pedestal carved from zurkhwood, with a 10-foot-high sculpted spider at its head.

subject: priestess’s tower
fact: The priestess’s tower’s chamber has eight polished jet eyes on the spider statue: four small ones worth five gp each and four larger ones worth ten gp each.
source_quote: The eight “eyes” of the spider statue are eight pieces of polished jet — four small ones worth five gp each and four larger ones worth ten gp each.

subject: priestess’s tower
fact: The priestess’s tower’s chamber has two heavy silver candlesticks worth 25 gp each, holding thick black candles and unlit.
source_quote: The altar is flanked by a pair of heavy silver candlesticks worth 25 gp each. They hold thick black candles and are unlit.

subject: priestess’s tower
fact: The priestess’s tower’s chamber has a rope ladder leading down from the shrine into the chamber.
source_quote: A rope ladder leads down from the shrine into this chamber.

subject: priestess’s tower
fact: The priestess’s tower’s chamber has walls hung with black mesh resembling a spider’s web, extending from the ceiling to the walls.
source_quote: Inside, the walls are hung with black mesh resembling a spider’s web, extending from a central spot on the ceiling to the walls, then draped down like curtains.

subject: priestess’s tower
fact: The priestess’s tower’s chamber has thick woven mats covering the floor.
source_quote: Thick, woven mats cover the floor

subject: priestess’s tower
fact: The priestess’s tower’s chamber has a low platform covered with cushions and pillows forming a divan-like bed.
source_quote: a low platform is covered with cushions and pillows to make a broad, divan-like bed.

subject: priestess’s tower
fact: The priestess’s tower’s chamber has a small table and two chairs on one side.
source_quote: One side of the chamber contains a small table and two chairs

subject: priestess’s tower
fact: The priestess’s tower’s chamber has a small shrine to Lolth draped in white silk.
source_quote: the other holds a small shrine to Lolth draped in white silk.

subject: priestess’s tower
fact: The priestess’s tower’s chamber has a heavy chest of black-stained zurkhwood at the foot of the bed.
source_quote: A heavy chest of black-stained zurkhwood sits at the foot of the bed.

subject: quaggoth barracks
fact: The cave to the north serves as a quaggoth barracks with one quaggoth resting inside.
source_quote: Their first stop is at the cave to the north, which they notice is a quaggoth barracks. Peeking in, Daz notes one of them resting.

subject: lake
fact: The lake is where chamber pots are disposed of and cleaned, and it appears unusually clean despite heavy filth deposition.
source_quote: they take the bucket to the lake, where they dispose of it and clean the filth. ... they notice that it is pretty clean, which is odd given the amount of filth being deposited.

subject: spider
fact: A spider is present above a pool of water near the prison cell, with a web below it.
source_quote: He looks a little bit more carefully and notices a spider web. Below the spider’s web, he notices a pool of water.

subject: quaggoth
fact: Quaggoths are present as attendants by the winch, waiting for signals to lower the basket.
source_quote: Two quaggoth attendants remain by the lift, waiting for a signal from below to lower the basket.

subject: quaggoth
fact: Quaggoths are present as prisoners forced to carry water with Ront and Prince Derendil.
source_quote: he watches the “Prince,” Ront, and Thorin filling buckets of water.

subject: drow
fact: Drow are present as guards and overseers throughout the outpost, including Beremil, Balok, and Ilvara.
source_quote: a Drow appears and points at Shuushar, Topsy, Turvy, and Gyrgum... The next Drow appears and points to Zalthir, Buppido, Jimjar, and Eldeth. Another Drow points at Daz, Sarith, and Stool.

subject: drow warriors
fact: Drow warriors gather in the mess hall cave, which serves as their eating and gathering place.
source_quote: The cave serves as a gathering and eating place for the drow warriors of the outpost.

subject: drow
fact: Drow worship Lolth as their spider goddess and operate the outpost as a religious and military center.
source_quote: This place is a shrine to Lolth, the drow’s spider goddess.

subject: kuo-toa
fact: Kuo-toa are present as prisoners, including Shuushar the Awakened, who seeks spiritual balance.
source_quote: The Kuo-Toan Shuushar the Awakened notices and tells him to relax... Shuushar mutters, “I see.”

subject: deep gnomes
fact: Deep gnomes are present as prisoners Topsy and Turvy, who steal knives during Gyrgum’s cooking.
source_quote: Topsy and Turvy whisper to each other... Topsy and Turvy steal several knives.

subject: derro
fact: Derro are present as prisoners, including Buppido, who believes he is divine and speaks of a divine plan.
source_quote: Buppido speaks, or instead projects his mind, “The Divine plan says we must collaborate and share information.” ... Daz learns from the cleric that Buppido thinks he is some kind of god, or he is a god.

subject: myconid
fact: Myconids are referenced as a potential destination group, with Stool being their representative.
source_quote: Stool objects, “No to the great circle! My people!”

subject: basket being lowered
fact: Balok pulls a stopper and the basket flies over the chasm.
source_quote: Balok pulls a stopper, and the basket flies over the chasm.

subject: basket being dropped
fact: The two quaggoths let the basket drop, startling the other prisoners.
source_quote: The two quahogs let it drop. The other prisoners are startled but seem to have been expecting this.

subject: Zalthir pocketing paper
fact: Zalthir pockets a piece of paper with names of debtors while cleaning the basket.
source_quote: As the basket bounces, Zalthir notices a piece of paper with some names of people who owe a favor to the person who has the paper. It’s unclear where, which city, what favor, and why. But he pockets the paper.

subject: Elspeth pocketing comb
fact: Elspeth finds and pockets a comb after noticing Zalthir pocket the paper.
source_quote: He notices that Elspeth sees him pocket the paper. He notices that she finds a comb. She pockets the comb.

subject: Gyrgum entering cave
fact: Gyrgum enters a cave as the basket comes up.
source_quote: As the basket comes up, he notices Grygum entering a cave.

subject: Guldor taking knife
fact: Guldor takes the knife from Gyrgum after noticing his attempt to steal it.
source_quote: Guldor notices and Grygum explains that he is just trying to sharpen the knife. Guldor takes the knife and says a bunch of words whose intent is quite clear.

subject: Topsy and Turvy stealing knives
fact: Topsy and Turvy steal several knives during Gyrgum’s cooking show while the Drow are distracted.
source_quote: As Gyrgum, with theatrical flair, tosses ingredients into the air, moves like a dancer, and hums a tune, Topsy and Turvy steal several knives.

subject: Zalthir examining winch
fact: Zalthir uses cleaning duties to examine the winch’s spider silk and gears for escape opportunities.
source_quote: This time, though, he uses the cleaning to examine how he can damage the winch to aid their escape. The two things that attract his attention are using spider silk to hold the basket and the winch and gears that the spider silk goes through.

subject: Zalthir taking rope sample
fact: Zalthir takes a small piece of rope to test its resistance later.
source_quote: He takes a small piece of rope to test its resistance later.

subject: Jorlan offering escape plan
fact: Jorlan offers to leave the prison door open and create a distraction so the prisoners can grab weapons and flee.
source_quote: I will leave the door to the prison open, create a distraction. The path to the armory will be unguarded. Grab the weapons and flee.

subject: Buppido proposing escape to Gracklstugh
fact: Buppido declares that the escape destination is Gracklstugh, his homeland.
source_quote: Buppido smiles, “To Gracklstugh, my homeland!”

subject: Shuushar proposing path through Menzoberranzan and Darklake
fact: Shuushar proposes going to Darklake first to visit his people before continuing the escape.
source_quote: Yes, but the direct path is through Menzoberranzan. We will have to go to Darklake first, and we must visit my people to share the enlightenment! From there, the path is good.

subject: Jimjar proposing betting on escape route
fact: Jimjar proposes a bet on which escape route the new prisoners will choose.
source_quote: Jimjar adds, “Who wants to bet on which path the new guys will want to go? Will they go with the myconid kid? The enlightened kuo-toan? The Destiny Weilding Derro? Or trust the two deep gnomes?”

subject: Zalthir asking about paying debts
fact: Zalthir asks how the group will pay their debts since they have no money.
source_quote: Zalthir asks, “We have no money; how do we pay our debts?”

subject: divine plan
fact: Buppido claims a divine plan requires collaboration, information sharing, and distraction for his escape.
source_quote: Buppido speaks, or instead projects his mind, “The Divine plan says we must collaborate and share information.” ... Buppido says, “The divine plan requires that you create a distraction while I escape.”

subject: escape planning
fact: The prisoners are discussing multiple escape routes: Gracklstugh, Blingdenstone, Darklake, and using waterfall or spiderwebs.
source_quote: Buppido smiles, “To Gracklstugh, my homeland!” ... Topsy says, “We should go to Blingdenstone. I know there is a way out of the Underdark from there.” ... Shuushar objects, “Yes, but the direct path is through Menzoberranzan. We will have to go to Darklake first...” ... Jorlan says, “Use the waterfall to slide down, or jump into the spiderwebs and then jump into the pools of water.”

subject: group mind
fact: Stool’s spores create a group mind among the prisoners, enabling covert coordination.
source_quote: The stool is happy to be talking to everyone and has spread his spores so that everyone in the prison cell is in a group mind. ... Daz notes that this allows them to coordinate any plans without being discovered.

subject: Ilvara’s pep talk
fact: Prince Derendil recalls Ilvara’s phrase: ‘Accept your fate, learn to obey, and you may survive.’
source_quote: Mistress Ilvara liked to impress her will with a scourge in hand and remind her slaves that our lives now belong to her. Every time, she would end her pep talks with the phrase - ‘Accept your fate, learn to obey, and you may survive.’

subject: 4th day of the 2nd Tenday of Taraskh
fact: The next day, Gyrgum returns to the kitchen with six Drow soldiers present.
source_quote: 4th day of the 2nd Tenday of Taraskh... The next day, Gyrgum goes to the kitchen again. This time, six Drow soldiers are present.

subject: kitchen
fact: The kitchen is part of the mess hall and contains unfamiliar ingredients that Gyrgum uses for theatrical cooking.
source_quote: He then turns to the kitchen, looks around, and realizes that he’s not a great cook and that many ingredients are unfamiliar

subject: knife
fact: Gyrgum attempts to steal a knife from the kitchen, and Topsy and Turvy later steal several knives.
source_quote: Grygum notices a knife and tries to steal it. ... Topsy and Turvy steal several knives.

subject: Grygum
fact: Grygum is repeatedly referred to as the prisoner who cooks for the Drow, despite the spelling variation from Gyrgum.
source_quote: As Grygum walks towards the mess hall... As the basket comes up, he notices Grygum entering a cave.
